violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Observed ice machine soiled with a black, pink film
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM will clean and sanitize ice machine. Ice machine is out of service.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the Chlorine solution was measured at more than 200 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of Chlorine solution at 50 - 200 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CFM diluted the sanitizer to 100 ppm

violations.title: Restriction
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed home defense insect killer during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CFM removed the home defense insect killer from the facility.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed boxes of power tea, cups, straws stored on the floor in dry storage and restroom (used as a storage).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM will use just the dry storage with approved shelving unit to store food items and utensils, disposables etc. BoBaPoP Tea Bar (Inspection Date: 10/30/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited in Toilet Rooms
violations.observation: Food storage in toilet rooms. Observed boxes of tea powder, straws, cups, paper towel store in a bathroom that is not longer used.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored in toilet rooms.CFM will relocated all boxes of tea powder, straws, cups, paper towel to the dry storage.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Sanitizer tray observed empty, with no sanitizer solution available for sanitizing wiping cloth.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM prepare sanitizer tray at 100ppm.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Observed spoons store in room temperature standing water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM wash, rinse, sanitize spoons and store in a dry container.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed 3- compartment sink at 92F. Three-compartment sink equipped with a malfunctioning mixing valve. Water temperature measured at 92°F. The cold water faucet was unable to close completely, preventing the sink from reaching the required hot- water wash temperature.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. CFM will repair the malfunctioned faucet. After repaired make sure the water temperature is at minimum 110F.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrive 10 min after

violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager.
